name: Mori Michiru
source:
A lively underclassman who admires Shinji and had decided to join the archery club because of him. Michiru has a small frame and looks younger than his real age. He is from the same school and grade as [url=/c16017]Shirakawa Tsuguo[/url]. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050407195831/http://zui.co.jp/products/kashoku/kashoku.html]official website[/url].]
